items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I was playing with Charles Everett from quarter after 8 to quarter of 12 at Greenland.

ctx.x: When you went to Pekin to play, you mean Oliver was playing there at the same time?
Oliver played at Dreamland from 8.30 to 1. Yes. And I was playing with Charles Everett from quarter after 8 to quarter of 12 at Greenland. It was on the northwest side of Chicago.
